children: New Delhi, Sept. 10 -- A Tata Group stock surged almost 10% in morning trade on the BSE on Thursday, 10 September, defying weak stock market sentiment. Tata Investment Corporation share price opened at Rs.618.55 against its previous close of Rs.618.30 and jumped 9.8% to an intraday high of Rs.679, with a nearly 12 times spurt in volume. The stock, however, pared gains and traded 4% up at Rs.643 around 10:45 AM, looking set to snap its four-day losing run. Equity benchmark Sensex was flat at that time.
